cases.input: Three people apply to two openings under one recruitment process.
cases.expect: Normatively, three candidacies reference three person anchors without duplicating people.

cases.input: An issued offer is withdrawn with authority and reason.
cases.expect: Normatively, the offer version and withdrawal remain immutable while candidacy outcome changes.

cases.input: A prior applicant applies again years later.
cases.expect: Normatively, a new candidacy reuses the person anchor and preserves lineage.

cases.input: Two records sharing an email are automatically merged as one person.
cases.expect: Normatively, the merge is rejected without authorized evidence.

cases.input: Highest assessment score automatically becomes the selection decision.
cases.expect: Normatively, the inference is rejected.

cases.input: Possession of a CV authorizes indefinite cross-company reuse.
cases.expect: Normatively, the use is rejected without a separate scoped basis.

cases.input: A person participates in an internal-mobility campaign without an asserted opening.
cases.expect: Normatively, a candidacy is valid with explicit campaign or process scope.

cases.input: An application is minted as a sibling root and owned by the opening.
cases.expect: Normatively, the identity and ownership collapse is rejected.

cases.input: A match score is stored as an opening property.
cases.expect: Normatively, the score is rejected unless represented as an attributable evaluation or process result.

cases.input: The same person has two active candidacies for the same opening.
cases.expect: Normatively, the duplicate active scope is rejected.

cases.input: A closed candidacy reaches disposition while its hiring decision must be retained.
cases.expect: Normatively, cV material is minimized or purged while Person and Decision lineage remains.

cases.input: A later rehire silently restores a previously purged CV.
cases.expect: Normatively, the restoration is rejected; a new scoped submission is required.

cases.input: A stage occurrence omits processDesignReleaseRef.
cases.expect: Normatively, it is non-conformant.

cases.input: Status is offered with no offerRefs.
cases.expect: Normatively, it is non-conformant.

cases.input: One subject has two active candidacies in one internal campaign.
cases.expect: Normatively, the duplicate is non-conformant.

cases.input: A sourced lead has only public-profile provenance.
cases.expect: Normatively, a provisional subject is used and no Person is minted.

cases.input: A submitted candidacy has no noticeVersion.
cases.expect: Normatively, it is non-conformant.

cases.input: A bound document has no dataClass.
cases.expect: Normatively, it is non-conformant and retain-all fallback is forbidden.

cases.input: Monitoring data is cited as assessment input.
cases.expect: Normatively, it is non-conformant.

cases.input: A legal hold arrives after disposition becomes due.
cases.expect: Normatively, disposition suspends while outcome and due date remain unchanged.

cases.input: A CV is sent to a vendor without a disclosure entry.
cases.expect: Normatively, the transfer is non-conformant.

cases.input: A sourced candidacy has no source channel or source reference.
cases.expect: Normatively, it is non-conformant.

cases.input: A closed candidacy is reused without new submission or pool consent.
cases.expect: Normatively, the reuse is non-conformant.

cases.input: Automation records rejection without actor or human review.
cases.expect: Normatively, the outcome is non-conformant.

cases.input: Biography is disposed after rejection.
cases.expect: Normatively, assessment and stage decision evidence survive while biography does not.

cases.input: An audit returns identified biographies without justification.
cases.expect: Normatively, access is non-conformant.

cases.input: The profile is exported as canonical with holds open.
cases.expect: Normatively, export is refused.

cases.input: The WM-ORG-008 narrowing is claimed satisfied before its spec exists.
cases.expect: Normatively, the claim is refused.

cases.input: A provisional relation is treated as binding.
cases.expect: Normatively, the use is refused.

cases.input: Declarative expectations are reported as executed tests.
cases.expect: Normatively, the report is refused.

cases.input: Two distinguishable seats are represented by two openings.
cases.expect: Normatively, this is provisional under the seat-identity hold.

cases.input: Two interchangeable seats use one opening with quantity two.
cases.expect: Normatively, this is provisional and seat consumption remains two.
